name: Neon Crossroads
description: Four chambers divided by solid cyan walls. Yellow bouncers occupy the upper-right and lower-left chambers; pink diamond eroders occupy the other two. Four cyan patrols travel the outer safe border. Start at bottom center, move sideways before entering a chamber, and reconnect each cut to the outer safe border. Walls block movement and do not close a cut. Reveal 75%. Layout and actor positions follow the supplied screenshot; speeds and behaviors use existing Classic rules.
